description: This file defines a lazy evaluation map structure (`MapValue`) with associated methods and an iterator, used within the Kubernetes API server codebase for deferred field evaluation.

classes.name: MapValue
classes.description: A lazily evaluated map structure that computes its values on first access, not thread-safe.

classes.name: iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing the MapValue, supporting conversion, equality, and iteration.

methods.name: NewMapValue
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new MapValue with a specified object type.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Adds a new field with its name and callback to the MapValue.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a key is known to the map.

methods.name: Iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the map.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the number of known fields.

methods.name: ConvertToType
methods.description: Converts the map to a specified type, only allowing its own type or 'Type'.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks pointer equality with another MapValue.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the registered type of the MapValue.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns an error indicating value access is not supported.

methods.name: resolveField
methods.description: Resolves a field by calling its callback if not already evaluated.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds a value by key, unescaping and checking existence.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, returning an error if not found.
